matches.label: World Cup final
matches.sync_method: period 1 at the scheduled kickoff (PFF date = polymarket gameStartTime); period 2 at period 1 start + its last PFF timestamp_s + 15 min half-time (PFF's video cuts the break)
matches.check: 2026-10-10, demo.odds --check: every goal's first move comes after its mapped time. ARG pen 23' moved at the award (15:21:52, 30 s before the kick), then +69 s; ARG 36' +46 s; FRA pen 80' moved at the award (16:41:41, 16 s before the kick); FRA 81' +89 s. A 16 min break would put the 80' award after its move, so the break is 15 min or a little under

matches.label: World Cup final 2026
matches.sync_method: Team to Advance (counts extra time), not the 90-minute win/draw markets. No PFF: the chart is one span from the scheduled kickoff to 22:02 UTC, when Spain's price reached 1.00 (the final whistle, about ±1 min). The clip is synced by its goal (sync, 08)
